## Data review checklist

- [ ] Every new physical component has its own JSON file.
- [ ] At least one source is present, accessible, and supports the submitted values.
- [ ] Unknown values are `null`, not guessed.
- [ ] Units and identifier naming have been checked.
- [ ] `npm run validate:data`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` pass.
